profile.title: Your profile
profile.desc: What we know about you, used only to judge which schemes you qualify for.
profile.signInTitle: Sign in to keep your details
profile.signInDesc: Your state, age and income decide which schemes you qualify for. Saving them means you are not asked the same questions on every scheme.
profile.formDesc: Only your state is needed. Every extra field sharpens what we can tell you, and you can leave any of them blank.
profile.sensitiveSummary: Sensitive details — optional, and only if you want them saved
profile.sensitiveNote: Category, disability status, marital status and land holding decide eligibility for many schemes. Filling them here means you are not asked again on every scheme. Leave them blank and we will ask only where a scheme genuinely needs one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Language, text size, and what happens to your data.
settings.languageDesc: The whole interface, including the assistant, follows this choice.
settings.textSizeDesc: Larger text throughout, for comfortable reading.
settings.languageCount: The whole interface changes, not just scheme text. {{count}} languages are complete enough to offer.
settings.remindersDesc: A note when a scheme you saved is about to close, and when a record you rely on changes. Nothing else.
settings.exportDescAccount: Downloads everything held against your account — profile, saved schemes, eligibility answers, checklists and conversations — as a file you can keep.
settings.exportDescDevice: Downloads everything held on this device — saved schemes, checklist progress and preferences — as a file you can keep.
settings.exportFailed: Could not reach the server for your account data. Nothing was downloaded.
settings.deleteAccountDesc: Erases your account and everything attached to it from our servers, as well as this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteDeviceDesc: Clears your saved schemes and checklist progress from this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.confirmAccount: This permanently deletes your account. There is no way back.
settings.confirmDevice: This clears everything saved in this browser.
settings.deleteFailed: Your account could not be deleted just now. Nothing was removed — please retry.
settings.dpdpNote: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act you can ask for an export or deletion of anything held about you at any time. The controls above do it directly.

landing.titleLine2: We'll find the schemes you can claim.
landing.desc: Central and state benefits are scattered across hundreds of portals, written in language most people cannot self-assess against. Search all of them here, in yours.
landing.searchLabel: Describe your situation to find schemes
landing.freeNote: Sign in with your mobile number to open the register — it is free
landing.benefitsTitle: Not every benefit is a cash transfer
landing.benefitsDesc: A scheme might pay money into your account, or it might cut the price of a pump set, write off a college fee, or open a training place. The register tells you which, before you spend a day on the paperwork.
landing.liveTitle: Every entry traces back to an official notification
landing.liveDesc: Each record carries the department that issued it, the date it was last checked against the source, and the notification reference. Anything unchecked for more than 90 days is flagged in the list rather than quietly left to age.
landing.registerUnreachable: The register is not reachable right now. Search will work again once the connection returns.
landing.howEyebrow: From not knowing to ready to apply
landing.howTitle: Four steps, and we stop before the form
landing.step1Body: Type it the way you would say it. No scheme names, no government vocabulary needed.
landing.step2Body: Answer a short set of plain questions and get a clear yes, partly, or no — with the reason.
landing.step3Body: Get the exact list for your case, including where to obtain anything you are missing.
landing.step4Body: We hand you over ready. The government portal remains the only place you file.
landing.limit1Body: No agent, no middleman, no fee. The official portal is the only place an application is submitted, and we never ask for your login to one.
landing.limit2Body: Every record links to the government notification it came from, so you can read the original order yourself.
landing.limit3Title: In the language you think in
landing.limit3Body: Ask a question in {{count}} languages and get the answer back in the same one.
landing.langDesc: Eligibility rules are hard enough in your own language and close to unreadable in someone else's. Switch at any time from the selector in the corner — the whole interface follows, including the assistant.
landing.faq1A: Yes. Signing in with your mobile number opens the register and lets it remember your saved schemes, your document checklist and your deadlines between visits. There is no separate sign-up — the same number creates the account.
landing.faq2Q: Does BharatAssist AI apply on my behalf?
landing.faq2A: Never. We take you as far as a complete document list and the correct official link. The government portal stays the only place an application is filed, and we never ask for the credentials to one.
landing.faq3Q: Where does the scheme information come from?
landing.faq3A: Every record traces back to an official government notification. Each one carries the issuing department, the notification reference and the date it was last checked against that source.
landing.faq4A: Records are re-checked against their source on a rolling basis. Anything unchecked for more than 90 days is flagged in the list rather than quietly left to age, so you can see the age of what you are reading.
landing.faq5A: Nothing. Government schemes are a public entitlement and finding them should not carry a fee, an agent or a middleman.
landing.faq6Q: What do you do with my mobile number?
landing.faq6A: It attaches your saved schemes to you and nothing else. We do not sell it or use it for marketing, and you can export or delete everything you have stored from Settings at any time.
landing.closingDesc: Most people find something they qualify for and did not know existed on their first search.
